title: Beartown
author: Fredrik Backman
current_text: In early March 2026, bookstore co-founder Artem Faustov was fined 50,000 rubles for selling Beartown.

sources.quote: The Leninsky District Court in Makhachkala fined the bookstore chain, Chitai-Gorod, on 16 March, according to Russian independent media outlet Mediazona
sources.title: OC Media: Makhachkala bookshop fined for LGBT propaganda in books by Le Guin and Backman

sources.quote: According to the case materials, the grounds for the protocol were the books Beartown and Us Against You by Swedish author Fredrik Backman
sources.title: OC Media (same article)

sources.quote: in early March 2026, Artem Faustov, co-founder of the bookstore Vse Svobodny, was fined 50,000 rubles ($670) for selling Fredrik Backman’s Beartown even though an expert review by the Russian Book Union had concluded that the book contained nothing prohibited.
sources.title: The Insider: In Putin's bad book

ban_rows.note: Banned in Belarus by addition to the Official List of Publications Harmful to National Interests (Ministry of Information). Decision: 2025-04-01. Country of origin: Sweden. Documented by PEN Belarus.

Russian booksellers were fined for selling the book: the co-founder of the bookstore Vse Svobodny, Artem Faustov, was fined 50,000 rubles in early March 2026, and a Makhachkala court fined the Chitai-Gorod chain (The Insider; OC Media).
